title: Eventual compatibility of a fixed family of local lifts
statement: Let $I$ be a directed preorder, $R:I\to\mathrm{CommRing}$ a functor with Noetherian rings $R_k$, and $c$ a limit cone of $R^{\mathrm{op}}\circ\operatorname{Spec}$ with affine vertex $S$. Fix $i\in I$ and a quasi-compact, quasi-separated, locally finitely presented morphism $f:X_i\to\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)$ [def-pc-scheme]. Put $X=X_i\times_{\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)} S$, and $X_j=X_i\times_{\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)}\operatorname{Spec}(R_j)$ for $j\geq i$ [def-pc-base-change]. Fix $j\geq i$, finitely presented quasi-coherent modules $F_j,G_j$ on $X_j$ [pqf-def-coherent], and a map $\varphi:(F_j)_X\to(G_j)_X$. Write X_t for the base change of X_i to Spec R_t. At a stage k ≥ j, let A_0 and B_0 be tensor pullback from X_j to X_k and from X_k to X, and e_0 their canonical comparison with direct pullback [def-pc-tensor-pullback-composition-iso]. Suppose a finite affine cover U_0 at stage k and a family r_0 of local maps are given, whose pullbacks recover phi through the canonical composition and restriction comparisons. For l ≥ k let q:X_l→X_k be the transition, A tensor pullback from X_j to X_l, B tensor pullback from X_l to X, e the canonical comparison with direct pullback, and z:A≅A_0 followed by tensor pullback along q the canonical composition comparison. There is a later stage l where the explicit conjugated pullback of r_0 on the pullback cover U is the component family of a descent-data morphism psi. The pulled-back cover is affine, and the same explicit family still recovers phi. The pullback family is defined using the canonical composition comparison z and the restriction comparison [def-pc-open-cover-tensor-pullback-comparison]; no new component maps are chosen.

source.place: Tag 01ZR, first proof, affine lifting and Zariski gluing; Algebra Tag 05N7

proof.text: Apply eventual_overlap_equations to the original stage modules, local family and recovered global map δ=e₀.inv(Fj) composed with φ composed with e₀.hom(Gj). It gives a later stage l and an affine pulled-back cover. In its global precomposition and postcomposition clause take F'=A(Fj), G'=A(Gj), κ=z.hom(Fj), and ρ=z.inv(Gj). This gives exactly the prescribed component family and its descent morphism. Apply recovery_transport to the four schemes X_j, X_k, X_l, X and the six base-change maps. The four map equations follow from baseChangeMap_comp, the cone equations and functoriality of Spec; the supplied e₀, e and z satisfy their canonicality equations by hypothesis or reflexivity. Its conclusion is exactly the required recovery equation. Combine affineness, the descent morphism with its components, and recovery. No new local maps or comparisons are chosen. The explicitly constructed family is named localMapPullbackFamily, and the identical original recovery equation is named localMapRecovery. These definition boundaries prevent repeated expansion in kernel checking; unfolding them gives the original formulas.

proof_origin.place: Tag 01ZR, first proof; F3 separates eventual equations from functorial recovery

theorem finitePresentation_local_maps_eventually_compatible
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u})
    (c : Cone (R.op ⋙ Scheme.Spec)) (hc : IsLimit c) [IsAffine c.pt]
    (i : I) {Xi : Scheme.{u}} (f : Xi ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f] :
    (∀ (j : I) (hij : i ≤ j) (Fj Gj : (pullback f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij)))).Modules),
      Fj.IsFinitePresentation → Fj.IsQuasicoherent →
      Gj.IsFinitePresentation → Gj.IsQuasicoherent →
      ∀ φ : (Scheme.Modules.moduleBaseChange f
            (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
            (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i)))
            (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op j)) (c.w (homOfLE hij).op))).obj Fj ⟶
          (Scheme.Modules.moduleBaseChange f
            (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
            (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i)))
            (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op j)) (c.w (homOfLE hij).op))).obj Gj,
      ∀ (k : I) (hjk : j ≤ k),
        let A₀ := Scheme.Modules.moduleBaseChange f
            (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
            (T' := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk)))))
            (Over.homMk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hjk)))
              (by dsimp; rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← R.map_comp]; rfl))
        let B₀ := Scheme.Modules.moduleBaseChange f
              (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk)))))
              (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i)))
              (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op k)) (c.w (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk)).op))
        ∀ (e₀ : Scheme.Modules.moduleBaseChange f
            (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
            (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i)))
            (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op j)) (c.w (homOfLE hij).op)) ≅ A₀ ⋙ B₀),
          e₀ = Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackCompositionIso
            (baseChangeMap f
              (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk)))))
              (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i)))
              (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op k)) (c.w (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk)).op)))
            (baseChangeMap f
              (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
              (T' := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk)))))
              (Over.homMk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hjk)))
                (by dsimp; rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← R.map_comp]; rfl)))
            (baseChangeMap f
              (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
              (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i)))
              (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op j)) (c.w (homOfLE hij).op)))
            (by
              rw [← baseChangeMap_comp]
              congr 1
              ext
              simpa using c.w (homOfLE hjk).op) →
        ∀ (U₀ : (pullback f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk))))).OpenCover.{u}),
          Finite U₀.I₀ → (∀ a, IsAffine (U₀.X a)) →
          let Q₀ := modulesPseudofunctor.toDescentData U₀.f
          let p₀ := baseChangeMap f
            (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk)))))
            (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i)))
            (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op k)) (c.w (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk)).op))
          let _V₀ := U₀.pullback₁ p₀
          ∀ r₀ : ∀ a, (Q₀.obj (A₀.obj Fj)).obj a ⟶ (Q₀.obj (A₀.obj Gj)).obj a,
            localMapRecovery p₀ U₀ (A₀.obj Fj) (A₀.obj Gj)
              (e₀.inv.app Fj ≫ φ ≫ e₀.hom.app Gj) r₀ →
          ∃ (j' : I) (hkj' : k ≤ j'),
            let hjj' := hjk.trans hkj'
        let A := Scheme.Modules.moduleBaseChange f
            (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
            (T' := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjj')))))
            (Over.homMk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hjj')))
              (by dsimp; rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← R.map_comp]; rfl))
        let _B := Scheme.Modules.moduleBaseChange f
              (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjj')))))
              (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i)))
              (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op j')) (c.w (homOfLE (hij.trans hjj')).op))
            let e := (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackCompositionIso
            (baseChangeMap f
              (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjj')))))
              (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i)))
              (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op j')) (c.w (homOfLE (hij.trans hjj')).op)))
            (baseChangeMap f
              (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
              (T' := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjj')))))
              (Over.homMk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hjj')))
                (by dsimp; rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← R.map_comp]; rfl)))
            (baseChangeMap f
              (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
              (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i)))
              (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op j)) (c.w (homOfLE hij).op)))
            (by
              rw [← baseChangeMap_comp]
              congr 1
              ext
              simpa using c.w (homOfLE hjj').op));
            let q := (baseChangeMap f
              (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk)))))
              (T' := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjj')))))
              (Over.homMk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hkj')))
                (by dsimp; rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← R.map_comp]; rfl)));
            let z : A ≅ A₀ ⋙ Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback q :=
              (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackCompositionIso q
                (baseChangeMap f
                  (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
                  (T' := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk)))))
                  (Over.homMk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hjk)))
                    (by dsimp; rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← R.map_comp]; rfl)))
                (baseChangeMap f
                  (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
                  (T' := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjj')))))
                  (Over.homMk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hjj')))
                    (by dsimp; rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← R.map_comp]; rfl)))
                (by
                  rw [← baseChangeMap_comp]
                  congr 1
                  ext
                  change Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hkj')) ≫
                    Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hjk)) = Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hjj'))
                  rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← R.map_comp]; rfl));
            let U : (pullback f
              (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjj'))))).OpenCover.{u} := U₀.pullback₁ q
            let Q := modulesPseudofunctor.toDescentData U.f
            let p := (baseChangeMap f
            (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjj')))))
            (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i)))
            (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op j')) (c.w (homOfLE (hij.trans hjj')).op)))
            let _V := U.pullback₁ p
            let r : ∀ a, (Q.obj (A.obj Fj)).obj a ⟶ (Q.obj (A.obj Gj)).obj a :=
              localMapPullbackFamily q U₀ (A₀.obj Fj) (A₀.obj Gj)
                (A.obj Fj) (A.obj Gj) (z.hom.app Fj) (z.inv.app Gj) r₀
            (∀ a, IsAffine (U.X a)) ∧
            (∃ ψ : Q.obj (A.obj Fj) ⟶ Q.obj (A.obj Gj),
              (∀ a, ψ.hom a = r a)) ∧
            localMapRecovery p U (A.obj Fj) (A.obj Gj)
              (e.inv.app Fj ≫ φ ≫ e.hom.app Gj) r)
